goal: Extend the LOOP_STATUS envelope parser so intent=blocked envelopes carry a validated tuple of structured requires predicates (command_grader, file_exists, env_var_set).

references: src/flywheel/envelope.py:32-37 -- existing ValidEnvelope shape that gains the requires field
src/flywheel/envelope.py:140-183 -- parse_envelope JSON-decode + per-field validation pattern to mirror for requires
constraints: Add a BlockedRequirement tagged-union family of frozen kw_only dataclasses in flywheel.envelope: CommandGraderRequirement(name: str), FileExistsRequirement(path: str, present: bool = True), EnvVarSetRequirement(name: str). No other predicate types in v1.
Add `requires: tuple[BlockedRequirement, ...] = ()` to ValidEnvelope. The field is empty for non-blocked intents and populated only when intent=blocked.

parse_envelope rejects any intent=blocked envelope that: (a) omits requires, (b) sets requires to a non-list, (c) sets requires to an empty list, (d) contains an entry that is not a JSON object, (e) contains an entry missing 'type' or with an unknown 'type', (f) contains a predicate entry missing per-type required fields or with wrong-typed fields. Each rejection returns MalformedEnvelope with a precise reason string and an offending snippet via the existing _truncate helper.

file_exists.present defaults to true when the key is omitted; reject when present is provided but is not a bool. env_var_set rejects when name is provided but is not a string (or is empty). command_grader rejects when name is provided but is not a string (or is empty). The parser does NOT resolve command_grader names against any Task -- that validation happens in the harness in a later task.

Non-blocked intents (verify, continue, abort) continue to parse with requires=() even if the envelope payload happens to include a requires key (ignore it for non-blocked intents -- matches the existing 'extra fields accepted' behavior tested at tests/test_envelope.py:65).
flywheel.envelope MUST stay pure: no new imports beyond stdlib json/dataclasses/enum/typing. The forbidden-imports allowlist in tests/test_envelope_module_purity.py must continue to pass unchanged.

Update tests/test_envelope.py: (a) fix test_envelope_with_intent_and_reason (line 29-37) and the parametrized test_each_closed_enum_intent_parses (line 40+) so any blocked sample includes a valid requires list -- they currently violate the new contract; (b) fix test_reason_must_be_string_when_present (line 155) which currently uses a blocked envelope without requires; (c) fix the duplicate-envelope fixtures at lines 173-208 that build blocked envelopes without requires; (d) add new tests covering: well-formed parse of each predicate type, missing requires -> MalformedEnvelope, non-list requires -> MalformedEnvelope, empty requires list -> MalformedEnvelope, unknown predicate type -> MalformedEnvelope, missing per-type field -> MalformedEnvelope, wrong-typed per-type field -> MalformedEnvelope, file_exists.present default true, file_exists.present=false accepted, env_var_set with empty name -> MalformedEnvelope, non-blocked intent with stray requires key still parses with requires=().

Update docs/loop.md 'Iteration envelope' section (around lines 46-59) so the blocked intent contract documents the requires field as mandatory, lists the three predicate shapes inline, and notes that non-blocked intents omit it. Keep the existing prose terse -- one example block per predicate type at most.
Run `mcp__ide__getDiagnostics` on every .py file you touch and fix all Pylance errors before reporting verify -- treat them as build failures.
Commit the change with a Conventional Commits message (e.g. 'feat:') before reporting verify.
non_goals: Do not touch src/flywheel/harness.py, src/flywheel/lifecycle.py, the persistence schema, or any store module -- those layers come in later tasks.
Do not add a fourth predicate type (manual_ack and friends are deferred per the spec's Out of Scope).
Do not validate command_grader.name against a Task -- the parser is task-unaware by design (FR-3).
Do not change the envelope fence syntax, intent enum membership, or the existing MissingEnvelope / TruncatedEnvelope / DuplicateEnvelope variants.
edge_cases: Duplicate predicate entries (same predicate twice) parse successfully -- no de-dup. The spec calls this out under Edge Cases.
An intent=blocked envelope whose requires entries are individually well-formed but whose JSON list itself is empty must MalformedEnvelope -- empty would unblock on first recheck.
A non-blocked envelope that nonetheless includes a syntactically-broken requires field is accepted (we never look at it). Verify the parser does not eagerly validate requires unless intent=blocked.

graders.run: uv run python -c "from flywheel.envelope import CommandGraderRequirement, FileExistsRequirement, EnvVarSetRequirement, ValidEnvelope, Intent; v = ValidEnvelope(intent=Intent.BLOCKED, requires=(CommandGraderRequirement(name='x'),)); assert v.requires[0].name == 'x'"
graders.name: api-smoke
